rule: Spin-offs in the sample. Prices are not adjusted for a distribution, so for a while the trailing (T) or fiscal-year (F, FY) EPS still holds the unit the price no longer does and the P/E reads cheap. After a confirmed ex-date: no new T plan for 365 days, no new F or FY plan until the end of that fiscal year (panel.build). Dates are from memory and count only once confirmed against the snapshot (the one-day move on the ex-date and panel's spin_candidates); open positions are not touched.
